findings.description: The verification table is written as one pipe-delimited line containing both the header, separator, and all rows. The local ItemBody HTML and tiles show it as a single run of pipe-delimited prose rather than a table, so its columns and pairwise comparisons are difficult to scan.
findings.suggested_repair: Put the header, Markdown separator, and each of the seven data rows on separate source lines. Preserve the existing values and comparison rule.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The item computes the first-difference linear order of all eight terminal branches of a specific finite binary tree. A small labeled tree would show the common prefixes and the coordinate where adjacent leaves first diverge; this directly supports the worked calculation.
diagram_candidates.concrete_structure: Root ε; levels 1, 2, and 3 consist of binary words; edges s→s0 and s→s1; leaves ordered 000<001<010<011<100<101<110<111. Mark the first-difference coordinate on each adjacent pair if space permits.

diagram_candidates.rationale: This finite example computes domain, range, inverse, restriction, image, and self-composition for one four-pair relation. An arrow picture makes the pair list and the two-step paths producing R∘R immediately checkable.
diagram_candidates.concrete_structure: Vertices u,v,w; directed edges u→v, v→w, w→u, and a loop u→u. For the self-composite, show all length-two paths and their endpoints: u→w, u→v, u→u, v→u, w→v, w→u.
